description.value: The Comox Community Centre is a civic facility operated by the Town of Comox, offering fitness programs, racquet courts, and rentable spaces to residents and visitors on Vancouver Island. It sits in the heart of the Comox Valley, a region popular with touring cyclists exploring coastal routes. The centre lists 'Accessible Recreation' as a program area, suggesting a commitment to welcoming a broad range of visitors.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 59m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 87m; rack (7 spaces) at 87m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch succeeded and returned content from comox.ca/rec, but all retrieved subpages consist almost entirely of site navigation menus with no substantive body text describing the Community Centre's specific amenities, facilities, or visitor services. OSM confirms the address, phone, and civic-building classification, and the website title 'Community Centre | Town of Comox' corroborates the name and URL. Without any amenity-describing content paragraphs, none of the required or optional criteria can be confirmed.
concerns: All fetched subpages returned navigation-menu content only; the Community Centre facilities detail page was not captured, leaving all amenity fields unverifiable.
Category 'Attractions' is a poor fit for a municipal community centre; a rest-stop or services category would better serve cyclists searching the directory.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Community Centre is a legitimate civic facility that touring cyclists could plausibly use, but none of the WWC required criteria could be confirmed because the fetched website content contained only navigation menus rather than facility detail pages. A deeper fetch of the facilities sub-page or a direct inquiry would resolve whether the listing meets minimum criteria.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Town of Comox navigation lists a Fitness Studio, Racquet Courts, and Accessible Recreation under the Community Centre umbrella, which would normally imply washrooms and change-room showers, but this cannot be treated as confirmed evidence under the rules.

provenance.category_correction_reason: A municipal community centre is more naturally a service or rest-stop facility for touring cyclists than a tourism attraction; consider recategorizing.

wow_evidence: Civic fitness/courts facility; standard band (KW rentals false positive).
blurb: Comox's community centre with fitness programs and courts.
